abilities.name: oblivious
abilities.effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against captivate.

abilities.name: regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

kanto.flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

original-johto.flavorText: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.

hoenn.flavorText: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

updated-johto.flavorText: A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

original-unova.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

updated-unova.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

kalos.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.

original-alola.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

updated-alola.flavorText: Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can easily be found lying around, they’re a precious ingredient for cooking.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

swsh.flavorText: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
